name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_zmod
title: Leaf view over Z_q with norm-checked succinct-LWE trapdoors: real (no trapdoor for B) vs simulated, within twice the LHL bound
statement: Over Z_q with the box sampler (small box ball s, big box of Bb bits): if the public check good(T) implies entries of T_B and T_W at most E_T, the attribute w is binary, phi(0) = phi(w) = 0, the succinct-LWE block identity holds on good outputs of the setup kernel S, and s + k * errBound k ((mW + l) E_T) phi <= 2^(Bb-1) - 1, then the real leaf view (attribute 0, key sampled with the simulation trapdoor of A = B R, no trapdoor for B) and the simulated view (A = sum_i w_i W_i + B R) are within 2 * mW * sqrt(q^n / 2^m) / 2.
